title: Emerald Jhumka Elegance Blouse
imageAlt: Emerald green Aari blouse embroidery with gold oval motifs and jhumka tassels
summary: An emerald green blouse with ornate gold oval borders, scattered motifs and traditional jhumka-style back tassels.
description: The front showcases a rounded neckline framed by repeated gold oval motifs, with matching embellished sleeve cuffs and a coordinated lower border. The back features a wide U-shaped neckline, scalloped oval embroidery, tie strings and paired jhumka-style tassels. The rich green-and-gold palette gives the design a traditional festive and bridal feel.

specs.workType: Aari-style gold embroidery · Beadwork · Jhumka-style tassels
